pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions or placing multiple correlated tickets within a 10-pip range during high-frequency volatility regimes.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution allowed within 5 minutes prior to and following tier-1 macro news releases; volume-weighted momentum confirmation required on the 1M chart.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger immediate partial or full SENTINEL_PEAK_HARVEST when floating profit hits the +$15 to +$30 band to prevent profit evaporation.
